demonstration_agreement.reason: The existing eight-task Fresh cache stores policy chunks only. No correctly aligned expert action table is present in the existing protocol/artifacts, and expert labels will not be reconstructed from questionable paths.

reliability_context.source: historical git artifact at 6ed5d06: experiments/dynamic_reliability_horizon/oracle_group_horizon_metrics.json and source_context_ablation/*
reliability_context.target_definition: Y_refresh(k) is prefix survival of old cached A_t[k] against fresh cached A_{t+k}[0]. Arm is valid when max(translation normalized RMS, rotation normalized RMS) <= 1.0; gripper is valid when normalized absolute error <= 1.0 and command signs agree.
reliability_context.comparability: Semantically compatible with source-age persistence, but it is a frozen ACT artifact on a different cohort and is not numerically pooled into this SmolVLA H_temp score.
reliability_context.reuse: Report validated group-wise reliability curves and hard-horizon failure as supporting interpretation only.

interpretation_limits: Same-target differences mix observation-delay effects with SmolVLA stochastic flow variation because sampling was not keyed by physical step.
Revision utility is an offline consistency proxy, not a causal estimate of control quality or closed-loop success.
Candidate rows are support counts only; task and episode summaries are the aggregation units.
